description: Parts of upstream/ars510_radar.py (2.5; line counts unchanged since 2.4): code lines (no comments, docstrings or blank lines; shared constants counted once), the evidence for each, what removing it costs on the 27 replay drives, and its status for an upstream openpilot PR.

parts.part: transport, CRC, slot decode, track IDs, ego speed, RadarInterface wrapper

parts.without: +24 unjustified hard ticks on 27 drives; with the 0.25 x scale, one road late brake -1.47 -> -2.36 m/s2
radar-only braking x3 (age 6); age 40: further-drive hard ticks 1 -> 9; age 80: more missed braking vs the oracle (3.3 -> 3.7 s on 2.3)

parts.part: range fusion (incl. ACC distance as the followed car's range)
parts.without: braking neutral; lead flips +39 %, target episodes 4 -> 6
parts.upstream: keep for lead stability; droppable at that cost

parts.part: ego-speed alignment (0.149 m/s per code instead of the DBC 0.15)
parts.without: neutral (onset +12 ms); folded into the decode factor, so it costs no line
back to 2.1 (removed with the 0.4 x match): held-out target episodes 3 -> 4, owner 0 -> 1, further hard ticks 1 -> 2; two road false brakes
parts.upstream: candidate: keep, or move into radard as a lateral gate

parts.part: far cars the radar does not follow (beyond 60 m only the ACC target's)
parts.without: 2.5 over all four drive sets (16.9 moving h): oracle unnecessary braking 21.6 -> 28.5 s, lead flips 334 -> 418 /h, second car 0 -> 1 hard; with it a fast far closing waits ~1 s for the radar to make the car its ACC target

parts.part: stationary tracks path-gated close in too
parts.without: all four drive sets: hard radar-only episodes 12 -> 8 (ticks 30 -> 16), mild 49 -> 26 with it; missed braking unchanged (parked cars at the curb while turning, a parked car alongside)

parts.part: fork compatibility (CP_SP argument, points assigned as a list)
